intro.title: Display Values
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple webpage that demonstrates how different CSS display values affect the layout and behavior of HTML elements. You will learn the core concept of the CSS display property and its common values like block, inline, and inline-block. The main technology involved is CSS, using style rules to control element presentation. By the end, you will understand how to use display values to create basic web layouts and control element flow.
intro.usecase: Understanding display values is essential for creating responsive layouts across modern web applications. Developers use display: flex to build navigation menus and card grids in e-commerce sites, while display: grid organizes dashboard panels and data tables. Display: inline-block controls button groups and form elements, and display: none toggles mobile menus and modal dialogs. Mastering these values allows you to structure interfaces efficiently, from social media feeds to admin panels.
